notes.title: Version 1.02
notes.notes:
This is a minor maintenance update which was required to make this game Steam Deck verified.

If you encounter any issues with this new version, please report the issue on this thread and switch to the oldstable beta for the time being.

notes.title: Steam deck fix
notes.notes: Hotfix for an issue some Steam Decks have with Renpy games which would cause the game to randomly freeze up for a minute

notes.title: Version 1.01 + trading cards
notes.notes:
This is mostly a maintenance release, but it does contain one thing returning players might want to check out in spoiler tags at the end of the post.


Updates include:

[list]
[*] new character bio screen

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36766424/7081332f7625a11e79e90db80ccc7eea1ef5e6e7.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36766424/ad3855a183b15cc1ef5524965dadf2bd3d1b5488.jpg[/img][/url]

[*] new glossary screen

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36766424/fcc4a7dcc3a54a76e6174006cfac41f68562aebd.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36766424/252fd6c76cd3d67733c320577d06ca34f30b8113.jpg[/img][/url]

[*] game engine updated to Renpy 7.5.3

[*] updated disclaimer screen (no more white text on an empty black background)

[*] cafeteria music track has been improved

[*] dead links removed from credits page

[*] improved keyboard/controller support in several places
[/list]


Steam-specific changes:

[list]
[*] cloud saves added

[*] trading cards added

[*] windows and linux builds are now split into separate 32 and 64 bit depots to reduce download/install size
[/list]


For players who have already finished the True End, there is one minor addition you might be interested in. (Spoilers in case you haven't finished playing yet)

[spoiler]
The game now has a post-credits image which announces that Man And Elf will be continued in an upcoming game: My Elven Bride.
The post-credits image shows a background from My Elven Bride, as well as the logo.

To save you from replaying the game just to see one new image, here you go:

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36766424/ef26f1aae90b937140b88016b4c4f334a14d1324.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36766424/eb5046571e899a15006ecd910f984307a5ef197c.png[/img][/url]
[/spoiler]

notes.title: A Dragon's Treasure released
notes.notes:
Sable's Grimoire: A Dragon's Treasure has now been released.

Continue Drakan's route from the end of Sable's Grimoire as we delve deeper into Sable's relationship with dragonkind.
